    Prop

    The missing support/factorization assertion: under the committed full-head unitary, rho_x(a) is head-supported, the word operator is supported on the HeadIsnt x tail, and the Boca vacuum is the corresponding product vacuum. Equivalently, compression by the Boca vacuum factors over that head/tail split.
